# SI052 — float-in-storage-or-compare

Avoid floats in storage and aggregation.

## Why

Floating-point rounding can differ across runtimes. Use integers, enums, or explicit binned values.

## Bad

```python
score: float
```

## Good

```python
score_band: str  # LOW | MEDIUM | HIGH
```

## Suppression

```python
# safetynet-disable-next-line SI052 -- reason
```
